Round 2 boys. First time nature won, lets hope I win this time.

Glad to hear you're having so much fun with it! The best cure for mold is prevention. Personally, I live pretty far north and grow indoors, so I am probably not the best outdoor teacher, but I would recommend staying away from any auto strain. Auto flowers are ruderalis mix. You're 3 options with marijuana are sativa, India, and ruderalis. Most strains are hybrids, I dislike anyruderalis mix because the flowering is controlled by age of the plant, not photoperiod. Are you watering by hand or by other means? What kind of soil / soil-less mixture are you using? Is it in a pot or in the ground? What are the general humidity levels of your area?

Thanks! I haven't decided on soil mixes this time around quite yet, I'm still waiting for my seeds to come in but last time I did Fox Farms Ocean with some bloodmeal, worm castings, bonemeal, perlite, vermiculite, and hawaiian black lava cinder, in 6ish gallon plastic pots. I also foliared it with mixes of Alaskan Fish Emulsion during veg and the Alaskan bloom during flower and occasionally sprayed them with neem oil. I think I'm going to try something something similar this time around but try bags instead of pots and instead of using bloodmeal and bonemeal just get a box of organic 4-6-2 tomato fertilizer and mix that in. I also think I'm going to hold off foliar feeding during flowering to reduce mold potential. I watered by hand, but only when the rain wasn't enough...call it 50/50. I'm thinking about covering them this time around and only watering by hand. A local grower told me no water should ever touch the flowers near harvest.
